notes: Separate from previously reviewed pg_catalog index DDL run69, table columns/constraints run70, view column declarations run71 and view SQL run26: no double credit.
Catalog descriptor metadata only; no compiled PostgreSQL source, planner runtime, Auth identities, member data, sensitive settings or private statistics.

System catalog relhasindex=false on index relations is normal; view rewrite-rule flag true is normal. Public view SELECT ACL grants require separate secured-view behavior analysis; no universal exposure conclusion.
